limitations.description: The audited OULAD benchmark dataset contains 200 total samples (120 train, 40 validation, 40 test).
limitations.why_it_matters: Small sample sizes heighten susceptibility to partition variance and reduce statistical power.
limitations.restricted_claim: Claims regarding asymptotic convergence or scalability to thousands of students.
limitations.future_experiment: Benchmark across full 32,593 OULAD student record cohort.

limitations.description: Held-out test split consists of 40 records (27 non-dropout, 13 dropout).
limitations.why_it_matters: A single sample misclassification shifts accuracy by 2.5% and F1 by approximately 3-4%.
limitations.restricted_claim: Fine-grained precision claims beyond 2 decimal places.
limitations.future_experiment: Implement 5-fold cross-validation or larger stratified holdout.

limitations.description: Evaluation was conducted over 5 stochastic seeds [42, 123, 456, 789, 1024].
limitations.why_it_matters: Degrees of freedom df=4 leads to wide Student-t confidence intervals and low statistical test power.
limitations.restricted_claim: Strong claims of population-level statistical significance.

limitations.description: Proximal term was evaluated at order-of-magnitude steps mu in {0.001, 0.01, 0.1}.
limitations.why_it_matters: The optimal regularization value may lie between 0.005 and 0.05.
limitations.restricted_claim: Claiming mu=0.01 is the universally optimal proximal parameter.
limitations.future_experiment: Perform fine-grained Bayesian hyperparameter optimization over [0.001, 0.1].

limitations.description: All models evaluated using frozen artifact v_1_1786778298.
limitations.why_it_matters: Imputation and one-hot encoding strategies were fixed.
limitations.restricted_claim: Generalization across alternative data preparation pipelines.
limitations.future_experiment: Evaluate sensitivity across alternative scaling and encoding strategies.

limitations.description: SHAP, LIME, and Integrated Gradients identify feature predictive attributions.
limitations.why_it_matters: High attribution (e.g. total_vle_clicks) reflects statistical association, not necessarily causal driver.
limitations.restricted_claim: Recommending educational policy interventions based purely on attribution ranking.
limitations.future_experiment: Conduct causal inference and do-calculus intervention analysis.

limitations.description: Privacy preservation is achieved via gradient decentralization without raw data transfer; differential privacy (DP-SGD) noise was not added.
limitations.why_it_matters: Decentralization prevents direct data sharing, but formal (epsilon, delta)-DP bounds against reconstruction attacks are not guaranteed.
limitations.restricted_claim: Claiming formal mathematical differential privacy guarantees.
limitations.future_experiment: Integrate DP-FedAvg with RDP accountant to quantify privacy-utility tradeoff.

limitations.why_it_matters: Real-world university consortia may involve 10 to 100 institutions with variable bandwidth.
limitations.restricted_claim: Generalization to large-scale cross-silo or cross-device federated networks.
limitations.future_experiment: Simulate scale-up to K=20 and K=50 clients with client dropout/stragglers.

limitations.why_it_matters: Tree-based models (XGBoost) or TabNet might exhibit different centralized vs federated gaps.
limitations.restricted_claim: Claiming MLP is the optimal model family for academic tabular data.
limitations.future_experiment: Compare against Federated Gradient Boosted Trees and TabNet.

limitations.description: Deterministic reproducibility verified on PyTorch CPU generator.
limitations.why_it_matters: Atomic operations in CUDA kernels can introduce floating-point non-determinism across GPU architectures.
limitations.restricted_claim: Bitwise exact reproducibility across heterogeneous GPU hardware.
limitations.future_experiment: Benchmark determinism across NVIDIA A100 / Apple Metal platforms.

claim_evidence_mapping.research_question: Does Non-IID label skew degrade Federated Averaging performance relative to IID on student dropout prediction?
claim_evidence_mapping.claim: Non-IID client heterogeneity (Dirichlet alpha=0.5) degrades FedAvg F1 performance under the tested configuration.
claim_evidence_mapping.evidence: FedAvg IID achieved mean F1 = 0.4386, whereas FedAvg Non-IID achieved mean F1 = 0.3672 (mean paired drop = -0.0714, paired t = -1.5543, p = 0.1951).
claim_evidence_mapping.effect: Mean paired degradation of 0.0714 F1 points
claim_evidence_mapping.limitation: N=5 seeds; small sample setting (200 total records); exploratory statistical power.

claim_evidence_mapping.research_question: Does FedAvg IID exhibit greater stability across random seeds than FedAvg Non-IID?
claim_evidence_mapping.claim: FedAvg IID exhibits lower across-seed F1 variance (std = 0.0498) than FedAvg Non-IID (std = 0.0728).
claim_evidence_mapping.evidence: IID F1 std = 0.0498 vs Non-IID F1 std = 0.0728 across N=5 seeds.
claim_evidence_mapping.uncertainty: Sample std computed with ddof=1 over N=5 seeds
claim_evidence_mapping.limitation: Restricted to Dirichlet alpha=0.5 partition model.

claim_evidence_mapping.research_question: Is FedProx performance sensitive to proximal regularization parameter mu under Non-IID skew?
claim_evidence_mapping.claim: FedProx performance and stability are sensitive to mu under Non-IID partition skew.
claim_evidence_mapping.evidence: mu=0.01 achieved zero class collapses (mean F1=0.3969), whereas mu=0.001 collapsed on Seed 456 (F1=0.0) and mu=0.1 collapsed on Seed 123 (F1=0.0).
claim_evidence_mapping.effect: mu=0.01 stabilizes gradient divergence without class collapse
claim_evidence_mapping.limitation: Grid search evaluated 3 points; fine-grained optimal mu was not explored.

claim_evidence_mapping.research_question: Can small-sample federated learning experience minority-class collapse under extreme label skew?
claim_evidence_mapping.claim: Extreme Dirichlet partition draws on small datasets can cause minority-class collapse in federated optimization.
claim_evidence_mapping.evidence: Observed F1=0.0000 and Recall=0.0000 on Seed 456 (mu=0.001) and Seed 123 (mu=0.1), where models predicted majority class only.
claim_evidence_mapping.effect: Complete collapse to zero positive predictions on severe skew partitions
claim_evidence_mapping.uncertainty: Occurred in 2 out of 15 FedProx seed runs (13.3% rate)
claim_evidence_mapping.limitation: Specific to small client dataset sizes (40 samples per client).

claim_evidence_mapping.research_question: Does multi-seed evaluation reveal stochastic variance obscured in single-seed pilot testing?
claim_evidence_mapping.claim: Multi-seed evaluation (N=5) reveals significant partition-induced variance not observable in the single-seed pilot.
claim_evidence_mapping.evidence: In Seed 42 pilot, FedProx mu=0.001 (F1=0.5000) and mu=0.1 (F1=0.5789) appeared optimal, but multi-seed revealed both suffered collapse on other seeds.
claim_evidence_mapping.effect: Single-seed evaluation gave false confidence in unstable mu values
claim_evidence_mapping.limitation: Further seeds (e.g. N=20) would provide tighter distribution bounds.

claim_evidence_mapping.research_question: Is the experimental pipeline fully reproducible under the deterministic RNG isolation protocol?
claim_evidence_mapping.claim: The multi-seed benchmark is 100% reproducible with unique model checksums and execution-order independence.
claim_evidence_mapping.evidence: 30 distinct model checksums verified; execution order independence verified; exact metric replication verified across test runs.
claim_evidence_mapping.uncertainty: Deterministic on CPU; GPU non-determinism not tested
claim_evidence_mapping.limitation: Verified on Linux x86_64 CPU environment.

claim_evidence_mapping.research_question: Do different XAI methods (SHAP, LIME, IG) achieve consistent feature attributions on dropout prediction?
claim_evidence_mapping.claim: SHAP, LIME, and Integrated Gradients exhibit measurable feature-ranking agreement, with engagement metrics ranking highest.
claim_evidence_mapping.evidence: Top-5 feature overlap: SHAP & LIME = 3/5 (Jaccard=0.4286); SHAP & IG = 4/5 (Jaccard=0.6667); Consensus = total_vle_clicks, avg_assessment_score, studied_credits.
claim_evidence_mapping.effect: Substantial feature agreement across distinct explanation paradigms
claim_evidence_mapping.uncertainty: Agreement measures attribution consistency, not ground-truth causality
claim_evidence_mapping.limitation: Attributions are predictive correlations, not causal mechanisms.
